name: wal_buffers
description: Number of 8kB buffers in shared memory dedicated to holding WAL data before it is written to disk.
symptoms: Transaction commit slowdown under high concurrency
WAL buffer contention (high wait events on WALWriteLock)
tuning_tips: Set to -1 (auto) to use 3% of shared_buffers, or manually tune between 4 (-1 maps to ~64kB) and 2048 (16MB); increase only if WAL write stalls or high commit latency are observed under load.
